data.title: One Big Difference Between Bitcoin and Pearl: There’s ‘No True Fair Launch Anymore’
data.description: Ryan Watkins, Co-Founder of Syncracy Capital, responds to criticism of Pearl’s $55 million raise and concentrated mining, saying insiders hold about 5% of supply and no launch since Bitcoin can be truly fair. From Unchained, the no-hype resource for all things crypto.
